title: Preparation of mesoporous nanosphere SiO2@TiO2 composite materials and the photocatalytic degradation performance of different dyes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9280-9292
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09917J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenqian Wu, Weiye Yang, Jiuming Zhong, Hongyan Peng, Lijian Meng, Shihua Zhao
In this research, anatase-phase SiO₂@TiO₂ spherical photocatalysts were prepared via sol–gel method. Calcination parameters, catalyst dosage, and degradation performance toward RhB and various pollutants were systematically investigated.
